legend.water.jpMetadata: Follows the source metadata; unknown values are not filled in.
legend.water.jpSupplyNote: P21 has no consistent subcategories; types are conservatively inferred from 2010 facility names, and unmatched ones stay unclassified.
legend.water.jpSewerNote: P22 pump stations and treatment plants are distinguished by the source subtypes P22a / P22b.
legend.water.jpGroundwaterNote: 1,293 source records verified; they cover 24 prefectures, so an empty view does not mean there is no data nationwide.
legend.water.jpNilimNote: 583 source records verified; they cover 46 prefectures, the year is not provided, and they are not added to the KSJ dams.
legend.water.jpPondsNote: 161,778 source records verified; positions are candidates with an unknown datum, and 4,284 rows with identical coordinates are kept.
legend.water.jpFloodTitle: GSI (Geospatial Information Authority of Japan) official XYZ tiles (z2–17)
legend.water.jpFloodAlt: GSI official legend for expected flood inundation depth
legend.water.jpFloodNote: Maximum-scale inundation assumption; blank does not mean no risk, and this is neither a real-time disaster report nor a forecast. Coverage still has some gaps. The color scale is the official legend as-is.
legend.water.measureDust: PM10 / wind speed / temperature and humidity
legend.water.lakesNote: Features overlapping the fish pond layer (39.1%) are filtered out | OSM ODbL
legend.water.deltaSub: Water level change today Δ (vs start of day)
legend.water.sewerNote: Updated every 60 seconds (Taipei Hydraulic Engineering Office)
legend.water.pumbSub: Inner pool level / maximum allowable level
legend.water.rainNote: Circle size = 10-minute rainfall | below z12 a heat zone in the same colors is used
legend.water.zoneNote: Groundwater region polygons are drawn as a thin outline only (fill 8%)
legend.water.monitorNote: Station locations only (no readings) | for readings see Rain Gauge / River Level / Groundwater Wells
legend.water.floodDisclaimer: Model simulation for disaster preparedness only; not a basis for land-use regulation
legend.water.reservoirNote: The number below each dot is the fill rate and updates with the timeline. Turn on "3D effect" to add 3D water gauges (column height = fill rate).
legend.water.rpiNoData: No RPI data (does not mean clean)
legend.water.rpiSource: Ministry of Environment river water quality monitoring (WQX_P_01) · Open Government Data License, version 1.0
legend.water.rpiNote: Official four classes: RPI ≤2 unpolluted or slightly polluted, ≤3 light, ≤6 moderate, >6 severe. Updated monthly with a delay of about 2 months; the color reflects only the latest sample at that station, not a long-term average.
legend.water.wqHollow: Hollow: no reading (does not mean clean)
legend.water.wqSource: Ministry of Environment, Water Resources Agency (Ministry of Economic Affairs), Taipei Feitsui Reservoir Administration · Open Government Data License, version 1.0
legend.water.wqNote: Shows only station locations and the latest sampling date, not whether water quality is good or bad; 607 stations with no coordinates or coordinates outside Taiwan are not drawn.
legend.water.sewageSource: Ministry of the Interior, data.gov.tw 26496 · addresses geocoded with Google
legend.water.sewageNote: 14 of the 82 plants are located only to an area center or approximate position; a point is not the plant site.
legend.water.dzTitle: Drinking water source quality protection zones (Ministry of Environment)
legend.water.dzSource: Ministry of Environment GISEPA_P_13 (2026-07-20 edition) · Open Government Data License, version 1.0
legend.water.dzNote: Announced under the Drinking Water Management Act. Its legal basis and extent differ from the water resources "Control Zones" (tap water quality and quantity protection zones designated by the Water Resources Agency under the Water Supply Act), so the two must not be treated as the same layer.
legend.water.reservoirStaticNote: The embedded map shows reservoir extents and dam locations only, without live water levels.
legend.water.gbRiversGbHeading: Great Britain (OS Open Rivers, by type)
legend.water.gbRiversNiHeading: Northern Ireland (DAERA, by Strahler order, unnamed)
legend.water.gbRiversZoom: Named rivers and NI order 4+ from z6; others from z9
legend.water.gbHydroGridPrecision: Hollow: location only to a 1 km grid square
legend.water.gbHydroCoverage: Coverage 2/4: England, Scotland; Wales and Northern Ireland: not covered
legend.water.gbHydroNoReadings: Station locations only, no live readings; shown from z7
legend.water.gbFloodZoom: Built defences from z7, natural high ground from z10
legend.water.gbFloodScotland: Scotland: artificial coastal defences only; inland flood defences not covered
legend.water.gbDynamicCoastNote: Dynamic Coast analyses cannot be used for property-level assessments
legend.water.gbErosionNi: Northern Ireland: {version} high-level risk appraisal (lines, not a projection)
legend.water.gbErosionNotComparable: Methods and scenarios differ by nation; colours are not on a common scale and cannot be compared across nations
legend.water.gbErosionPeriodNote: Long term shown by default; switch period in layer settings. Shown from z8
legend.water.gbBathingNoClass: Northern Ireland: no classification in source (not poor)
legend.water.gbBathingYear: Classification year: England 2025; Wales and Scotland sources do not state a year
legend.water.gbBathingDesignated: Shows the {count} currently designated sites (de-designated hidden); coverage 4/4
